verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: The son of man sets your faces towards the mountain of Sion, and he stands upon it.
verses.3: And you said to him, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: I am your mountain, and I have placed my hand over you. I will cover you with darkness.”
verses.4: You will be destroyed and laid low; but you will remain silent. Then you will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.5: For you were a source of eternal destruction for them. You caused the children of Israel to suffer greatly, through the hands of Hagar, during their time of distress and suffering.
verses.6: Therefore, O Lord YHWH, I say: I will make you into blood. Blood will follow you, if not for the blood that you love. Blood will indeed follow you.
verses.7: And I gave the mountain Seir to Shimmah and Shammah. And from there, I recognized that there was more to come.
verses.8: And I will fill your mountains with the ruins of their cities, and all your valleys and hills will be covered with destruction. All your cities will fall into ruin.
verses.9: May the names of eternity be upon you and your people. They will never be destroyed. And know that I am Jehovah.
verses.10: So that you may say, “These two nations and these two lands shall be mine. They shall be my inheritance.” And there shall be God there.
verses.11: Therefore, I say, O Lord Yahweh, I have done as you commanded me to do. I have done it out of your jealousy against them. And I know that this is what you intended for me to do.
verses.12: And you shall know that I, the LORD, have heard all your prayers. You said on the mountains of Israel, “They have been given to us as food.”
verses.13: They magnified me in their words, and they spoke of me in positive terms. I have heard them.
verses.14: So said Adonai YHWH: “When all the earth is at peace, I will do this for you.”
verses.15: When your joy shall be for the inheritance of Israel, since it has been sanctified in this way, then I will also sanctify you. You shall become a mountain of holiness, and all people shall know that I am Jehovah.
